copy.tagline: 编写更可靠的单元测试与集成测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在学习或改进测试策略
copy.tagline_en: Write more reliable unit and integration tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are learning or improving testing strategies

howto.what: Claude 会按照测试金字塔、AAA 模式等原则，帮你编写单元测试、集成测试和端到端测试，并指导 mock 策略、测试数据组织和命名规范。
howto.when: 当你询问如何编写测试、选择测试类型、组织测试代码，或要求生成测试用例时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个用户登录的单元测试，使用 AAA 模式。
这个函数应该用单元测试还是集成测试？
say.note: Claude 会根据测试金字塔原则给出建议。

say.text: 如何 mock 外部 API 调用？

howto.what_en: Claude will help you write unit, integration, and E2E tests following the testing pyramid, AAA pattern, and other principles, and guide on mocking strategies, test data organization, and naming conventions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about writing tests, choosing test types, organizing test code, or generating test cases.

say_en.text: Write a unit test for user login using the AAA pattern.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Arrange-Act-Assert structured test code.

say_en.text: Should this function be unit or integration tested?
say_en.note: Claude will advise based on the testing pyramid.

say_en.text: How to mock an external API call?
say_en.note: Claude will explain when to mock and which mock type to use.
